title: Software Engineer, New Grad — Backend Platform
jd_text: We're hiring new-grad software engineers for our backend platform team. You'll build REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot, work with Kafka-based event pipelines and Elasticsearch for our order-processing microservices, and ship code through CI/CD on Kubernetes. Requirements: BS/MS in CS or related field, internship or up to 2 years of professional backend experience, familiarity with Java, Spring Boot, and distributed systems. This is a full-time new-grad role based in San Jose, CA (hybrid).

title: New Grad Software Engineer — AI Agents
jd_text: Arcline AI is looking for a new-grad backend engineer to join our agent platform team. You'll design and build Python/FastAPI services that integrate GPT-4o and other LLMs into structured agentic workflows: reasoning, tool-calling, and follow-up-action pipelines over large internal datasets. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications (prompt engineering, structured-output parsing, agentic workflows) alongside solid backend fundamentals. Entry-level / new-grad, 0-2 years experience. Remote-US.

title: Software Engineer I — Backend Services
jd_text: Join our backend services team building internal platform APIs. Primary language is Java; services communicate over gRPC and Protobuf rather than REST, so prior gRPC experience is a plus. You'll also touch Kafka for event streaming. Entry-level position, 0-2 years of experience, degree in CS or related field required. Location: Austin, TX (onsite).

title: Associate Software Engineer — .NET
jd_text: We're looking for an associate software engineer to join our e-commerce platform team, building backend services in C# and .NET on Azure. You'll work on order and inventory APIs, SQL Server data models, and Azure Functions. Entry-level role, 0-1 years experience, CS degree required. Location: Chicago, IL (hybrid).

title: New Grad Data Engineer
jd_text: New Grad Data Engineer role building data pipelines in PySpark for our analytics platform, plus some light Python backend service work (Flask) to expose pipeline outputs via internal APIs. You'll also help maintain model-scoring batch jobs written by our ML team. Entry-level, 0-2 years experience. Location: Remote-US.

title: New Grad Frontend Engineer
jd_text: We're hiring a new-grad frontend engineer to build accessible, responsive UI components in React and TypeScript. You'll own component design, CSS architecture, cross-browser testing, and Storybook documentation. No backend work involved; this role is 100% client-side. Entry-level, 0-2 years experience. Location: San Francisco, CA (onsite).

title: Software Engineer — Backend (Java/Spring)
jd_text: We're hiring a backend software engineer to build Java/Spring Boot microservices on our trading platform, using Kafka for event streaming and PostgreSQL for persistence. This is a mid-level role: candidates must have a minimum of 5 years of professional backend engineering experience. Location: New York, NY (onsite).
